name: Snorunt
description: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites the target with cold-infused fangs to deal damage. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target. This may also leave the target with frostbite.
